newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania T-bill offer largely undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania T-bill offer largely undersubscribed.

text.p: An offer of 1.0 trillion lei of Romanian 91-day treasury bills was largely undersubscribed on Friday as five banks bought only 7.98 billion worth of new papers, central bank data showed.
Traders said they had not expected an undersubscription given the excess of leu funds on the money market, where one-week funds traded at some 34 percent.

The T-bills have a coupon giving an annual yield of 49.65 percent. The remaining bills will be offered on November 22, with an annual yield equalling the three-month Bucharest Interbank Bid Rate (BUBID) set five days ahead of subscription.
On Friday three-month BUBID was 49.40 percent.
The Finance Ministry, keen to cover a soaring state budget deficit, has also put on offer for November 14 an issue of 155.75 billion lei in three-month treasury bills .
January-August state budget had a 1.9 trillion lei deficit. The gap is forecasted to soar to 4.27 trillion by end-1996. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
